Rank 3 of the great beasts (creatureRank 3), under the Dragons, Leviathans and Dragon-Turtles. Unique (one a deck). Fire and shadow: Immolation 2 burns everything beside it and the enemy facing it each round, Shade halves non-magic hits at night and in the dark, and Scare 2 takes 2 off every attack at it.
